args.sql: SELECT * FROM observationalconditions LIMIT 5;
SELECT atmostransparency, humidityrate, windspeedms, lunardistdeg FROM observatories LIMIT 3;
SELECT pointaccarc FROM telescopes LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    o.observstation,
    t.telescregistry AS telescope,
    s.signalregistry AS signal,
    o.atmostransparency,
    o.humidityrate,
    o.windspeedms,
    o.lunardistdeg,
    t.pointaccarc,
    -- AOI calculation
    o.atmostransparency * (1 - o.humidityrate / 100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * o.windspeedms) AS aoi,
    -- LIF calculation
    (1 - o.lunardistdeg / 180.0) * (1 - o.atmostransparency) AS lif,
    -- OQF calculation
    o.atmostransparency * (1 - o.humidityrate / 100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * o.windspeedms) 
    * (1 - (1 - o.lunardistdeg / 180.0) * (1 - o.atmostransparency))
    * CASE WHEN t.pointaccarc < 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 2.0 / t.pointaccarc END AS oqf
FROM signals s
JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
LIMIT 5;

CREATE VIEW vw_observation_quality AS
SELECT 
    o.observstation,
    t.telescregistry AS telescope,
    s.signalregistry AS signal,
    ROUND(CAST(o.atmostransparency AS numeric), 4) AS atmos_transparency,
    ROUND(CAST(o.humidityrate AS numeric), 2) AS humidity_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(o.windspeedms AS numeric), 2) AS wind_speed_ms,
    ROUND(CAST(o.lunardistdeg AS numeric), 2) AS lunar_dist_deg,
    ROUND(CAST(t.pointaccarc AS numeric), 2) AS point_acc_arc,
    -- AOI: Atmospheric Observability Index
    ROUND(CAST(
        o.atmostransparency * (1 - o.humidityrate / 100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * o.windspeedms)
    AS numeric), 4) AS aoi,
    -- LIF: Lunar Interference Factor
    ROUND(CAST(
        (1 - o.lunardistdeg / 180.0) * (1 - o.atmostransparency)
    AS numeric), 4) AS lif,
    -- OQF: Observation Quality Factor
    ROUND(CAST(
        o.atmostransparency * (1 - o.humidityrate / 100.0) * (1 - 0.02 * o.windspeedms)
        * (1 - (1 - o.lunardistdeg / 180.0) * (1 - o.atmostransparency))
        * CASE WHEN t.pointaccarc < 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 2.0 / t.pointaccarc END
    AS numeric), 4) AS oqf
FROM signals s
JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
